description: Alternative Fourth-Way root composition with exactly the premises of CATHOLICISM-FROM-QUARTA-VIA-WITH-CLASSICAL-ATTRIBUTES except STMT-MOST-TRUE-IS-MOST-BEING. The maximum comes from QuartaViaMaximumInBeing.maximeEnsCausesBeingOfAll, which adds no premise to the route but applies the grades-to-maximum principle at truth and, when something having esse has a comparator, at esse, and actuality only insofar as being at truth. In the flat case the maximum is vacuous; genus and cause-more-such then leave one being having esse. The route still uses unrestricted cause-more-such, whose use at analogical being DISAMB-BEING-UNIVOCITY says needs independent justification, so it is not profile-clean. The truth bridge is omitted, not refuted or proved. The historical end remains a structural transcription conditional on revelation, history and authority bridges. All listed premises remain open, and the selected First-Way root route is unchanged. Shared INF-CATHOLICISM-QUARTA-VIA-CLASSICAL-WITNESS takes its maximum from STMT-MAXIME-ENS-CAUSES-BEING-OF-ALL; here that conclusion comes from INF-QUARTA-VIA-MAXIME-ENS-WITHOUT-TRUTH-BRIDGE, not the existing Fourth-Way inference its meaning names.
